notes: Car 4b — the execution-face trio: local browser automation, multi-backend terminal, and zero-key onboarding. (1) Browser automation over the local Chromium DevTools protocol with a pure-stdlib WebSocket client: six tools (browser_open / browser_snapshot / browser_click / browser_type / browser_screenshot / browser_close) over positional @eN refs re-resolved on every action, an http/https-only URL policy (chrome:/about:/file:/data: are refused with the reason), snapshots capped at 12000 chars, a singleton session with a 300s idle watchdog and atexit cleanup, and screenshots under data/browser/. Binary discovery is env AIDOG_BROWSER_BIN (authoritative — a set-but-invalid value fails loudly) then the Playwright cache glob then PATH; when nothing is discoverable the six tools are NOT registered and the registry carries an honest browser_note — never a fake capability. (2) Terminal backends: a mycore.shell settings line hot-switched on every call selects local (default, byte-identical to the historical run_bash contract), Docker (docker run --rm <image> / docker exec <container>), or SSH (BatchMode=yes so a missing key fails fast instead of prompting, accept-new host keys, shlex-quoted payload; passwords are never accepted — only an optional identity file path). The four hosted sandbox backends are deliberately not applicable under the free-for-use rule and are marked as such in docs/features/terminal_backends.md. The console validator delegates grammar to terminal.parse, so a bad spec is a 400 naming the key. (3) Zero-key onboarding: the setup wizard probes well-known local model servers (Ollama :11434, llama-server :8080, LM Studio :1234 — 0.5s cap each, proxy explicitly disabled, never raises) between settings provisioning and the manual base_url prompt; a hit is listed and adopting one writes base_url/model with the MODEL_API_KEY slot staying empty — no key needed, ever. A miss prints which endpoints were tried and falls through to the manual prompts; --check/--yes never probe. GET /api/capabilities gains three honest blocks: browser.available (agreeing with the registered tool set), terminal.backend (parsed kind only — the raw spec never serializes), and local_models (loopback-only records with userinfo stripped). Verified before these notes: the offline suite grew to 840/840 (+73 checks), console smoke to 123/123 (+13), the setup wizard suite to 99/99 (+19), and an E2E script ran 47 checks to completion — real browser open/snapshot/click/type/screenshot/close plus the dead-binary branch, a real Docker container command, a real refused SSH connection reported as exit=255 (never faked green), settings validation over the live console, fake local model servers detected end-to-end with the wizard adopting one over a real subprocess, and capabilities zero-credential assertion against every secrets slot — with settings and secrets restored byte-for-byte. Locale packs stay at 228 keys (en/zh), the site pack at 121, and handover/site/competitive figures were re-synced to the new counts (23 modules, ~7.3k LOC).
